name: CSS & Styling
description: CSS layout systems, visual design implementation, animations, responsive units, theming with custom properties, architectural methodologies, and modern CSS features.

subskills.name: Selectors & Specificity
subskills.description: CSS selector types, specificity calculation, cascade order, !important implications.

subskills.name: Box Model
subskills.description: Content, padding, border, margin — box-sizing, margin collapse, overflow behavior.

subskills.name: Flexbox
subskills.description: Flex container and item properties, main/cross axis alignment, flex-grow/shrink/basis.

subskills.name: CSS Grid
subskills.description: Grid template areas, auto-fit/auto-fill, named lines, implicit vs explicit grids.

subskills.name: Positioning & Stacking
subskills.description: Static, relative, absolute, fixed, sticky positioning; z-index and stacking contexts.

subskills.name: Animations & Transitions
subskills.description: CSS keyframe animations, transitions, GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity), will-change.

subskills.name: Responsive Units & Functions
subskills.description: rem, em, vh, vw, dvh units; clamp(), calc(), min(), max() functions for fluid design.

subskills.name: CSS Custom Properties
subskills.description: CSS variables (--custom-property), theming, runtime manipulation, fallback values.

subskills.name: CSS Architecture
subskills.description: BEM naming, ITCSS layering, CSS Modules, utility-first (Tailwind), CSS-in-JS trade-offs.

subskills.name: Modern CSS Features
subskills.description: Container queries, :has() selector, CSS nesting, subgrid, @layer, color-mix().

github.signal: Flexbox or Grid layout usage in CSS/SCSS files

cv.signal: CSS layout systems (Flexbox, Grid) in production
Design system or component library styling

junior.description: Understands the cascade, box model, builds layouts with Flexbox, and manages element positioning.

mid.description: Creates complex Grid layouts, implements performant animations, uses fluid typography, and maintains theme systems.

senior.description: Architects scalable CSS methodologies and adopts cutting-edge CSS features like container queries and :has().
